regions.name: Musi River
regions.quote: This species is known from the Siak River drainage southwards to the Musi River drainage in Sumatra, and from the Kapuas, and the Sampit (Mentaya) River drainage eastwards to the Sebangau River drainage in Borneo. Extent of occurrence (EOO) is estimated to be 540,000 km2, based on georeferenced points (GBIF 2019) and expert opinion (H.H. Ng pers. comm. 2019).
